proposedEntry.name: service-blueprint
proposedEntry.description: Makes the agent map service delivery as a five-lane blueprint (physical evidence, user actions, frontstage, backstage, support processes) separated by lines of interaction, visibility, and internal interaction; a nine-step construction process from scoping one scenario to validation with operations teams; a blueprint-vs-journey-map decision table; and diagnostic reading rules (gaps between lanes, dense backstage clusters, single points of failure, silent user waits).
